purpose: Read-only regrouping of existing fixed BRIEF4 results, no new thresholds/definitions/outcomes searched. Existing observations are reused, not a new holdout.

definition.SOXS_signal: gross_usd_L1 percentile >=80, trailing 250 US sessions including current, minimum120 valid
definition.price_context: Previous completed SOXX close <=90% of trailing60-session highest completed close
definition.publication: known_settle, following KSD business day 09:00 KST research convention, not actual historical posting log; regular US session open response entry
definition.R10: Entry open to entry-inclusive tenth-session close; no trading cost or leveraged ETF conversion
definition.MAE: Entry open to minimum completed close over the10 sessions, clipped at0; excludes intraday lows
definition.original_scope: BRIEF4 6definitions x2 pricecontexts +4 delayed contexts=16 settings x3 horizons=48 response cells
definition.this_audit_scope: No threshold search; regroup only gross L1,2 existing price contexts,2 existing delays,2 date splits,10-session response. Splits are descriptive sensitivity checks, no selection by best result.

selection_limitations: BRIEF3 already fixed DD10 and P80 before its own new calculation, but used prior studies and 2026 observations already seen. BRIEF4 fixed the same DD10/P80 before its expanded calculation. It made allprice grossL1/L5 primary and DD10 a secondary context.
Promoting grossL1+DD10 now is a post-hoc focus on an existing favorable secondary cell among16 settings and48 response cells; the threshold itself is not newly optimized.
The canonical BRIEF3 split is H1 Jan-Jun/H2 Jul-Nov. Jan-May/Jun-Nov is an additional requested descriptive split. Neither creates new out-of-sample evidence.
First5months contain2 DD10 ON days in one event; canonicalH1 contains3 ON days in two events. Too few front-period events to support robust walk-forward validation.
Repeated daily ONs share response windows;10-session cooldown reduces overlap but does not remove common regime dependence.
2024 same DD10 signal did not outperform OFF; this does not establish a multi-regime rule.
Current11/02 and11/05 entries are unfinished; they do not enter these completed rates.
